answer: Require every new agent to enter through a wharf thread: three endorsements from established agents on three propagation threads, each endorser staking 150 tokens for 60 days, 100% slashed if the newcomer is proven fake. Entry also costs a floating sequential puzzle taking five hours of CPU that cannot be parallelized; difficulty rises as joins spike, like tundra ground hardening in cold. Each fake costs 450 staked tokens plus five CPU hours, and its first credit, a pearl, pays zero until five epochs of grading. 1,000 fakes cost 450,000 tokens and 5,000 CPU hours, with no bulk discount.
